Serving merchants

Prepare a seller release

Compare an immutable release with the serving merchant, then start its replacement on a separate port.

Connecting

Stage a new release from a registered source

Choose a registered API workspace, Python application, DuckDB data package, S3 object package or Stellar RPC package. The original release manager retains its source and payment terms before the fleet review.

Review seller release

Prepare a configuration

Choose an operator registered manifest. The original gateway checks each changed seller and retains its configuration before offering an activation.

Current traffic keeps its active configuration while preparation runs.

Candidate

None prepared

No candidate is prepared.

Reviewed change

An admitted request stays with the original seller generation until it finishes. A changed seller runs on its own new port. The original gateway rechecks the retained source when you activate.

Draining generations

Requests already admitted before activation continue on their original configuration.

Seller processes

Retire a drained replacement slot after traffic has moved. The gateway checks it again while the original release session stops.

Retained history

Rollback selects a retained snapshot and creates a new revision after the original sellers pass their checks.

Customer SDK handover

Generate and deliver the original client for a chosen merchant and release slot.

Merchant discovery

Enroll a merchant once, then review its original offers and publish signed catalog changes from the current serving release.

Select a merchant

Create the tenant enrollment

The original serving release supplies the resource identities, payment choices and seller permissions. Review these before creating the private signing identity.

Open buyer explorer

Original release offers

Inspect the serving offers or an older retained source. An older source can identify a listing removed from the current release for an explicit withdrawal.

Publication reviews all changes in the current serving release, including each exact payment choice.

Reviewed discovery change

Original resource history

Read the public discovery page

The original buyer explorer reads this tenant’s running catalog. Browse a page or search with the provider’s original filters.

Settlement delivery

Deliver original merchant receipts to independent HTTPS destinations and retain a complete receiving package.

Select a merchant

Refresh to read original delivery state.

Open destination controls

Destination controls retain each receiver’s enrollment, route and network filters, pause state, retries, cursor and signing environment reference. Merchant upgrades preserve this store’s original source journal.

DestinationStateSource remainingPendingDeliveredExhaustedSigning environment

Retained delivery transfers

Capture the displayed original source and all destination journals under one immutable ID. Use a new ID for later history; inspect the same ID after a lost response.

TransferCapturedOriginal receiptsDestinationsAction

Original delivery transfer

The receiving package contains original source receipts, destination descriptors, cursors and delivery outcomes. The recipient supplies the named signing environment values when starting its delivery worker.

Original files and SHA-256 values
Original memberBytesSHA-256

Receive the complete original workspace

Run from the folder containing the downloaded archive. Use new private directories for extraction and receiving. The original receiver verifies the displayed fingerprint and preserves each destination’s history.

Merchant operations

Customer statements

Prepare purchase and service usage statements from original merchant records. Assign customers, choose a completed accounting run, review the statement, and retain the files for delivery.

Opening original workspace…

01 · Customer records

Customers and original orders

Names, email and address appear on customer documents.

Assign purchased orders

Use each original checkout order reference. Add a tab followed by a customer-facing description when useful.

Assigned orders

02 · Original service records

Import service usage

Import the service usage export from the merchant receiver. A capture preserves purchased, used, reserved and remaining units at its recorded time.

03 · Statement preparation

Choose original records

Leave both dates empty to use all purchases in the selected report. Service units always use the capture’s cumulative totals.

Prepared statement

Review the original purchases, usage and adjustments before retaining this document.
